localCheck.note: Complete 694-test local check passed before this small inheritance correction. The additional browser inheritance check passed locally. A subsequent complete local run was interrupted when the environment became unavailable; exact final-source CI is required.

browser.engine: Chromium Headless Shell 141.0.7390.37 / Playwright 1.56.1; isolated synthetic fixtures
browser.qualityScope: The initial 1920px envelope failures are superseded by six corrected shell views and nine corrected utility captures. A one-second unit-test wait timed out under concurrent browser load; the complete serial check passed all 694 assertions without modifying that test.
browser.utilityTraceNote: The original directory-contract result rows omit height; each belongs to the immediately preceding users capture in the same viewport loop. DOM censuses retain both dimensions, and the verifier now includes height on that row too.

publication: Branch snapshot. Exact-source CI, integration and deployment evidence are recorded in the delivery PR after these artifacts are frozen.
materialInheritance: Cards inherit their local DOM material. Existing portal primitives carry route context; consumers may explicitly provide their own style.
